step.cmd: Fact-find with the person who issued the ROE to obtain the missing information.
Determine if the person who issued the ROE was contacted.
In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Details: Document the fact-finding details according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy

step.cmd: Determine if the information has been obtained:
In ACS, send a registered copy of the Z-02-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li:
Opening Sentence to ER re: Request or Clarify ROE/RFS (2794)
Request ROE Opening Sentence - claimant

Request for a Record of Employment (2797)
Follow-up Request for ROE Additional Information
Date contacted employer (1556)
Enclosing a copy of letter (2800)
Date of BF (1540): Select 10 business days from the date the letter is sent.
Blank / Contact agent / Contact by phone or mail (11326)

Attachment List for Z-02-00-00 letter (3133) :
Copy of original letter

Indicate on letter how letter mailed (2804)
Sent by Registered mail.

step.cmd: In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Bring forward date : Enter 10 business days from the day the letter is sent.

step.cmd: When WI moves to the current workload, determine if the information was obtained:
Determine if a CA WI has been created.

ul.li: If no, go to Reassigning the WI to Level 1 . Reassigning the WI to Level 1

step.cmd: Create an SROC and complete the following fields:

ul.li: Comments: Type “Employer non-compliance — ROE [insert serial number].”
Details : Type “Employer did not respond to the Z-02-00-00 letter by response date of [DD-MM-YYYY]. Work item closed without corrections being made.”
